correctness.rationale: Positive-definite reversible killed generator; finite spectral mixture and strictly positive tilted spectral variance for nonconstant killing; conditional independent resets; Jensen uniqueness and segment-refinement strictness; derivatives through cubic order recover exactly equilibrium killing variance, centered third moment and the Dirichlet quadratic form. value.rationale: Capture before a finite deadline under a limited number of full equilibrium redraw opportunities is a natural transport control problem. The theorem gives universal strict global optimality and a sharp homogeneous-killing boundary; its quantitative expansion isolates the universal local-killing variance penalty and the first genuinely network-dependent penalty as a Dirichlet energy. A three-site path family exhibits identical stationary killing statistics but variable second-order graph correction. No downstream paper-scale theorem is assumed.
